title: A newborn sees clearly only about as far as a forearm
summary: MedlinePlus says a newborn can see within a range of 8 to 12 inches, about 20 to 30 centimeters.
body: The MedlinePlus newborn-development page, reviewed 1 January 2025, says vision for a newborn infant is a range of 8 to 12 inches, which it also gives as 20 to 30 centimeters. The sentence is a general encyclopedia line, with textbook chapters named as references. It is not the CDC milestone list, and it does not say that every newborn's range was measured.

sources.title: Infant - newborn development
sources.author: MedlinePlus
sources.note: Supports the sensory-development line that a newborn can see within 8 to 12 inches (20 to 30 centimeters).
